title: EvidenceGraph-AI Human Annotation Record
description: One human-review annotation slot for one claim (system_arm=verified) or one abstention question (system_arm=verified, claim-level fields null). Human fields are emitted EMPTY; they are populated only by an actual human reviewer. proposed_ai_label is an explicitly non-ground-truth secondary view and must never be counted as a human label. No default label of any kind is assigned to unreviewed items.

annotation_id.description: Stable identifier for this annotation slot within dataset version d1. Format: ann-d1-NNNN (zero-padded, queue order). Never reused across dataset versions.

schema_version.description: Version of this annotation schema. Bump on any field or allowed-value change; never edit records in place under a changed version.

item_type.description: claim = one extracted claim from a verified-arm answer. abstention_question = one zero-claim abstaining question reviewed at question level (human_label/claim fields left null; abstention assessment is recorded in human_label_slot per guidelines section F via review of the question).

question_id.description: Question identifier from data/sample/eval_questions.json (e.g. 'direct-03'). For claim items this is the question the claim was extracted from.

claim_id.description: Primary key verif_claims.id from the SOURCE run database (runs/eval-postgate22-20261016-141416/evidencegraph-eval.db). Null for abstention_question items. Preserved verbatim; never renumbered.

run_id.description: Source run. Primary queue is built on the Stage B post-gate run; the historical run id is allowed only for paired-reference rows if a future extension adds them.

system_arm.description: Which system arm produced the item. Only the verified arm yields claims (the baseline arm performs no claim verification by design); abstention questions are also assessed on the verified arm, with the baseline answer provided as paired reference in source_artifact_refs.

claim_text.description: Byte-verbatim claim text from verif_claims.claim_text (claim items). Null for abstention_question items.

paired_answer_texts.description: Paired question structure: the generated answers for this question from both arms of the SAME run, byte-verbatim from eval_results.answer_text. Lets reviewers compare baseline vs verified answers for one question without leaving the item. Immutable.

baseline.description: Baseline-arm answer text for this question (null if row missing; never reconstructed).

verified.description: Verified-arm answer text for this question (null if row missing).

retrieved_evidence_ids.description: Chunk ids the system cited for this claim, as stored in the source run (verif_claims.evidence_ids_json). For claims retracted by the grounding gate the post-gate store is empty by design; the originally-cited ids are recovered from the gate anomaly note and cross-validated against the historical run (13/13 agreed in Stage C) and recorded here with provenance in evidence_text_or_reference. Empty array means the system cited nothing; null means not applicable (abstention_question).

text.description: Verbatim chunk text from the source run DB copy; null if unavailable (never silently reconstructed).

selection_source.description: Why this chunk is shown: the judge cited it (stored or recovered), or it belongs to the question's retrieved set, which is a deterministic BM25 reconstruction validated 22/22 against stored retrieved_count (Stage C). Text itself is always verbatim from the run DB regardless of selection_source.

evidence_text_or_reference.description: Evidence shown to the reviewer: every cited chunk with verbatim text and stable reference (chunk_id + document external id). For abstention questions: the retrieved passages (reconstruction validated 22/22 against stored retrieved_count in Stage C, marked as reconstruction). Unavailable fields are marked, never invented.

system_verdict.description: The system's stored verdict (verif_claims.label) for claim items; 'abstained_no_claims' for abstention questions; null never occurs in d1 but is allowed by schema for future rows. DISPLAY: hidden in the blind queue; present only in the full queue and only after the reviewer has recorded a first judgment (or consciously waived blinding).

system_diagnostics.description: System-output diagnostics, shown ONLY in the full queue (null in the blind file). Never ground truth; for reviewer context and later analysis only.

anomaly_notes.description: Verbatim anomaly strings from verif_claims.anomalies_json (e.g. the grounding-gate retraction note with its grounding ratio, or a pre-existing rule note).

grounding_ratio.description: Grounding ratio parsed from the gate anomaly note (0.00-0.47 observed); null for non-gate anomalies and normal claims. Bar is 0.50 (judge config, not a human threshold).

system_verdict_visibility.description: Anti-confirmation-bias control. blind_first_judgment_required: reviewer must judge from human_review_queue_blind.csv first. visible_acknowledged: reviewer explicitly chose to see verdicts (record in uncertainty_notes why).

proposed_ai_label.description: NON-GROUND-TRUTH secondary view only: the AI-draft label from runs/eval-pilot22-20261014-181354/human_claim_review56.md where a (question_id, claim_id) mapping exists. NEVER a human label; never counted in agreement or accuracy statistics; excluded from the blind review file. Null when no AI draft exists for the item (e.g. abstention questions, or post-gate-only claims).

proposed_ai_label_source.description: Human-readable provenance string for proposed_ai_label (e.g. 'AI-assisted draft, human_claim_review56.md sha256:867876…; provenance=ai_generated_draft per stage_d_provenance_audit.md'). Null when proposed_ai_label is null.

human_label.description: THE human judgment (dimension A/B combined per guidelines: corpus-grounded factuality of the claim as written). EMPTY (null) until a human supplies it. For abstention_question items: the question-level abstention assessment uses this field with values appropriate_abstention/inappropriate_abstention/uncertain — see abstention_assessment field below for the dedicated field; on claim items this field is the claim label. No default value is ever assigned.

human_rationale.description: Reviewer's free-text rationale for human_label, citing specific evidence (chunk ids) and quoting the supporting text. EMPTY until supplied by a human.

evidence_sufficiency_rationale.description: Reviewer's assessment of dimension B (evidence sufficiency): does the retrieved evidence support the SPECIFIC claim rather than merely discuss the same topic? Quote or name the exact span(s). EMPTY until supplied by a human.

citation_support_label.description: Dimension C: does the cited passage actually support the claim it is attached to? not_applicable = the claim cites nothing (or citations are unavailable); null = not yet reviewed. EMPTY until supplied by a human.

citation_support_rationale.description: Reviewer's rationale for citation_support_label. EMPTY until supplied by a human.

abstention_assessment.description: Dimension F, question-level, for abstention_question items only: was abstention appropriate given the corpus? inappropriate = answer-bearing evidence was present in the retrieved/corpus text. not_applicable on claim items. EMPTY until supplied by a human.

reviewer_id.description: Identifier of the human reviewer, ONLY if the reviewer supplies one (e.g. 'reviewer-1'). Never invented by tooling. Null = anonymous review.

review_timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of when the human actually supplied the judgment. Written only by the review-collection step when real annotations arrive; null in the initial queue.

review_status.description: Workflow state. All d1 records start as not_reviewed. needs_adjudication is set when a second reviewer disagrees; adjudicated when an adjudicator has recorded adjudicated_label.

uncertainty_notes.description: Reviewer's uncertainty, disagreement, or caveats (e.g. 'compound claim: second clause unverifiable', 'chunk boundary artifact'). Also records deliberate blinding waivers. EMPTY until supplied by a human.

adjudicated_label.description: Final label after adjudication of a reviewer disagreement. EMPTY unless adjudication actually occurred. 'unresolved' records an honest failure to adjudicate; it is not a correctness claim.

adjudication_rationale.description: Adjudicator's rationale. EMPTY unless adjudication occurred.

item_priority.description: Review priority tier: 1=retracted claims, 2=surviving supported claims, 3=abstention questions, 4=stratified unchanged sample, 5=pre-existing anomaly / other anomalies.

claim_row_source.description: Stable reference to the originating row, e.g. 'runs/eval-postgate22-20261016-141416/evidencegraph-eval.db :: verif_claims.id=37 (verified arm)'.

run_db_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the source run database at queue-generation time, pinning the exact bytes reviewed.

paired_baseline_answer_ref.description: Reference to the baseline-arm answer for the same question (paired structure), e.g. 'eval_results.id=5 (baseline)'.

historical_claim_ref.description: For retracted claims: reference to the historical pre-gate row that retained the original citations, e.g. 'runs/eval-pilot22-20261014-181354/evidencegraph-eval.db :: verif_claims.id=12'.
